name: v2-arcs-ijk
approved_by: Claude independent analytical review (scripted kinematic model; not physical-board)
review: Independent checks against the commanded G-code, not the simulator: radii and sweep direction of all 230 arc blocks within 0.008 mm; per-move durations of the five moves against a trapezoid model (100 mm/s^2, F3000 = 50 mm/s) using the recorded boundary speeds and exact arc lengths (10, 47.12, 47.12, 62.83, 47.12 mm) differ by 0.02%, 0.01%, -0.54%, -0.02%, 0.04%. Known anomaly: block 105 (line 5) lasts 0.0473 s where the model needs 0.0554 s (decel 117 mm/s^2, over the 100 limit); the reference records current V2 behaviour including it, and a fix would legitimately change the reference. Two simulator runs gave identical traces. Not a physical-board measurement.
